name: devfleet-health-daily
description: Daily ChainSafe Lodestar dev-fleet health check (Nico, Discord #lodestar-private 2026-10-06). SSH read-only probe of all dev hosts via scripts/devfleet/health-check.py (inventory private in ~/.config/devfleet/hosts.txt); posts to #lodestar-private only when a new or worsened issue appears (plus a weekly reminder).

payload.message:
DEV FLEET HEALTH CHECK (isolated automation, daily). This job monitors the ChainSafe Lodestar dev fleet, read-only. Nico asked for it in Discord #lodestar-private on 2026-10-06: "check on all of these servers once a day, if there is any issue, report it here". You are the cheap first pass. Hand anything new to a stronger model (Nico, DM 2026-10-06).

1. Run `python3 ~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/devfleet/health-check.py` via exec with an explicit timeout of 300s. It prints either a line starting with `NO_REPORT` or a ready-to-post Discord report with sections **New** / **Still open** / **Resolved**.
2. If stdout starts with `NO_REPORT`, reply exactly NO_REPLY and stop.
3. If the report has NO "**New**" section (only resolutions or the weekly reminder): post stdout VERBATIM with the message tool (action=send, channel=discord, target="channel:605818244036821012"). Then run `python3 ~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/devfleet/health-check.py --ack` and reply NO_REPLY.
4. If the report HAS a "**New**" section: FIRST post stdout VERBATIM with the message tool (action=send, channel=discord, target="channel:605818244036821012"), then run `python3 ~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/devfleet/health-check.py --ack`. The report must be posted and acked before any triage, so a triage failure can never swallow it. THEN call sessions_spawn with model "anthropic/claude-opus-5-5", label "devfleet-triage", context "isolated", cleanup "keep", and a task containing the full report text plus these instructions:
   "You are triaging new findings from the daily read-only ChainSafe dev-fleet health check. The report is already posted to Discord and acked; do NOT repost it and do NOT run --ack. Verify each finding listed under **New** by hand, read-only, via `ssh -p 3022 devops@<ip>`. The IPs are in ~/.config/devfleet/hosts.txt; never print or post them. Run only inspection commands (df, smartctl, journalctl, systemctl status, docker ps/logs, cat /sys/block/md*/md/array_state, curl to local REST). Never change anything on the hosts. For each finding, decide whether it is confirmed or a false positive. For a confirmed finding, write one short line with the likely cause and a suggested next step for ops. For a false positive, say why (so the script can be tuned). Then post ONE follow-up Discord message with the message tool (action=send, channel=discord, target=\"channel:605818244036821012\") starting with **Triage**, one line per new finding. No @mentions."
   Reply NO_REPLY whether or not the spawn succeeds; the report is already out.
5. If the script itself errors (traceback, missing inventory, no output), post ONE line to the same channel: "⚠️ dev fleet health check failed to run: <short error>". Do not ack. Then reply NO_REPLY.

Rules: this job only observes and reports. Never change anything on the hosts (no restarts, cleanup, or config edits), even if a fix looks obvious. Never post IP addresses. No @mentions.
